description: Reads the current schema version from schema_meta.
docstring:
Return the schema version currently applied to this database.

Args:
    conn: An open connection.

Returns:
    The integer version from the most recent schema_meta row, or 0 if schema_meta does not exist yet (a database that has never been initialized).
postconditions: Never raises for a well-formed connection, even against a completely empty database file

edge_cases.input: Database has no tables at all
schema_meta has multiple rows (should not normally happen)

unit_tests.name: test_returns_zero_for_uninitialized_db
unit_tests.description: A brand-new in-memory connection with no schema returns 0.

unit_tests.name: test_returns_applied_version_after_init
unit_tests.description: After initialize_schema, returns the current target version.
unit_tests.expected: the constant CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION defined in schema.py
